name: lance_file::versions::v2_1::writer::Writer::finish

Footer fields in order: u64 LE column_metadata_start, column_metadata_offsets_start, global_buffer_offsets_start; u32 LE global-buffer count and column count; u16 LE major2 and minor1; four-byte MAGIC LANC. Total40 bytes (rust/lance-file/src/format.rs:33-33). Return pipeline rows_written with size from awaited object shutdown. No checksum, terminator retry guard, uniform field-length validation or explicit footer alignment is added. A partial footer or shutdown error does not restore consumed encoders/metadata.

behavior: encode_batch_body reserves batch.data.len+1MiB with unchecked addition, copies full data into BytesMut, optionally clones batch core Schema via TryFrom<&Self>, serializes descriptor and appends it raw, recording one global entry; otherwise globals empty. Copy column buffer descriptors, Any-wrap column encoding, serialize full ColumnMetadata and append raw bytes, retaining(position,length). Page-table Arc values are borrowed; page/descriptor Vecs and encoded bytes allocate copies. ColumnInfo.index is ignored; output ordering is Vec order. Append column offset table then global offset table using LEu64 position,length pairs; counts cast unchecked to u32. Return body with original starts and column count page_table.len. No footer, count prefix, checksum or IO here. Mini mode has no global entry and may have coincident global-table/footer start. Extra batch.top_level_columns mapping is unused.
